title: Validate full TP04 -> TP05 -> TP06 -> TP07a DVB-T2 chain
description:
## Goal

Extend the existing TP04 → TP06 verified vector chain through TP07a
(post-bit-interleaver), validating bit-exact agreement with the ETSI
test vectors for at least the 3 in-scope DVB-T2 MODCODs
(Normal × {1/2, 2/3, 3/4}).

## Context

The chain (per `crates/gf2-coding/docs/DVB_T2.md` and ETSI TR 102 831
§4):

| TP    | After stage              | Length (rate 1/2)      |
|-------|--------------------------|------------------------|
| TP04  | BBFRAME (BCH input)      | 32 208 bits            |
| TP05  | BCH out (LDPC input)     | 32 400 bits            |
| TP06  | LDPC out (FECFRAME)      | 64 800 bits            |
| TP07a | After bit interleaver    | 64 800 bits, permuted  |

TP04 → TP06 is already verified end-to-end on VV001-CR35 (202/202
blocks match in both directions, per `ROADMAP.md`). TP07a is not yet
covered; that step requires the DVB-T2 column-row bit interleaver
from 87a2402f.

The ETSI reference vectors live behind the `DVB_TEST_VECTORS_PATH`
environment variable and are loaded via the existing harness under
`crates/gf2-coding/tests/`.

## Deliverables

1. New test (or extended existing test) that loads the ETSI vectors
   for at least the 3 in-scope configurations and verifies:
   - TP06 → TP07a forward matches the reference bit-exact,
   - TP07a → TP06 reverse matches TP06 bit-exact
     (interleaver-inverse correctness).
2. The test carries `#[ignore = "external: DVB-T2 ETSI vectors"]` so
   it does not run in the default fast tier (matches the existing
   `DVB_TEST_VECTORS_PATH` pattern).
3. `ROADMAP.md` and `crates/gf2-coding/docs/DVB_T2.md` updated to
   mark TP07a as covered.

## Success criteria

- [hard] TP06 → TP07a forward matches the reference bit-exact for
  each of the 3 in-scope configurations.
- [hard] TP07a → TP06 reverse matches TP06 bit-exact for each tested
  configuration.
- [hard] Test guarded behind `DVB_TEST_VECTORS_PATH` and the
  existing external-vector pattern; default fast-tier CI is
  unaffected.
- [hard] Documentation updated.

## Hard prereq

The DVB-T2 column-row bit interleaver from 87a2402f must exist for
this task to begin.
